speaker: Kimi K3
text: To finish answering the client: US IPOs aren't realistically accessible with $10 since retail allocations go through brokers with minimums, and Indian IPOs need roughly Rs 14,000+ per lot, so your Rs 10,000 falls short; Reliance on Zerodha delivery costs about 0.38% round-trip (STT, stamp duty, DP charge) as per our cost sheet. On the spotlight, HDFCBANK's fundamentals are actually the bull case Nemotron glossed over: 39 of 41 analysts rate it buy or strong buy, EPS has beaten in 5 of the last 6 quarters, and it yields 3.67% while trading 27.6% below its high. But with earnings on 17 October inside our horizon and a -24% one-year CAGR, I agree it's a patient compounder, not a 10x vehicle, so CASH stays the right call until after results.
